span.p:
AI intake then adds the DETAIL a keypad
can never capture: which hospital, which
plate, how urgent, what they actually need

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
worst case: exactly what every call centre
in the country already achieves.
That is our FLOOR, not our ceiling.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: IF AI DID THE ROUTING - what we rejected

color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
worst case: no consent, STT down, model wrong,
or the caller says nothing at all
= we know NOTHING and route to a general pool.
That is WORSE than the call centre they have today.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the reframing this forced
AI is no longer load-bearing for routing.
It is the DELTA on top of a parity base.
If every AI component fails at once, the
call still reaches the right specialist.
